channel.title: Ashish Aggrawal — Technical Log
channel.description: Notes on systems programming, C/C++, kernels and low-level performance.

item.title: Endianness and the raw pointer cast trap
item.description: Why casting a byte buffer straight to uint32_t* fails in production — byte order, alignment, strict aliasing — and the memcpy + ntohl fix.

item.title: Why abs(INT_MIN) returns a negative number
item.description: Two's complement is asymmetric — TMin has no positive counterpart, and negating it is undefined behavior.

item.title: Your signed-overflow check may not survive -O2
item.description: GCC and Clang can legally delete a post-addition signed-overflow check. Test the operands before the operation.

item.title: Floating-point addition is not associative
item.description: Finite precision breaks (a + b) - b, and that's why a compiler can't freely reorder or vectorize float sums.

item.title: Why a 'plain' pointer broke my lock-free queue
item.description: Exploring atomic operations and memory ordering.

item.title: The hidden cost of choosing the wrong variable type
item.description: Exploring portable types and why int isn't always the right choice.

item.title: 5 lines of PowerShell to clean up your GitHub portfolio
item.description: A small automation that saved a lot of clicking.
